description: This file contains generated Go code for protocol buffer message types and the gRPC service definition related to control environment proxy operations, including request and reply message structures for method calls, listing services/methods, type info, and request types.

classes.name: CallUnaryMethodRequest
classes.description: Request message for calling a unary method which includes service name, method name, and JSON formatted protobuf.

classes.name: CallUnaryMethodReply
classes.description: Reply message containing JSON formatted protobuf response.

classes.name: ListMethodsRequest
classes.description: Request message for listing methods of a specific service.

classes.name: ListMethodsReply
classes.description: Response message listing methods for a service.

classes.name: ListReqResTypeRequest
classes.description: Request message for listing request and response types for a specific method.

classes.name: ListReqResTypeReply
classes.description: Reply message containing request type name and response type name.

classes.name: TypeInformationRequest
classes.description: Request message for retrieving detailed type information.

classes.name: TypeInformationReply
classes.description: Reply message with formatted type information text.
